blocks.text: Inductor (jise coil ya choke bhi kehte hain) do terminals (sire) wala passive component (hissa) hai. Is ki self-inductance bohat zyada aur resistance na hone ke barabar hoti hai. Jab is mein current guzarta hai to yeh energy magnetic field mein jama karta hai. Current ke achanak surges ya spikes (uchhal) ko yeh dheema karta hai: energy thori der jama karta hai aur phir circuit ko wapas de deta hai.

Current chalta rakhne ke liye lagaya gaya voltage is back emf ke barabar hona chahiye. Is liye coil par voltage:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Δ/Δt ka matlab hai 'waqt ke saath kitni tezi se badal raha hai'. sin ωt ke change (tabdeeli) ka rate ω cos ωt hota hai. Akhir mein cos ko sin (ωt + π/2) likh kar pata chalta hai ke voltage current se π/2 aage hai.

blocks.title: For your information (aap ki maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: ΔI/Δt waqt ke saath current badalne ka rate (raftar) hai. Yahi I-t graph ka slope (dhalwan) bhi hai.

Eq. 17.15 se pata chalta hai ke inductor L par voltage current se aage (leading) hai; doosre lafzon mein inductor wale AC circuit mein current voltage se peeche (lagging) hai (Figs. 17.7(b) aur 17.7(c)). Inductor mein current hamesha voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) peeche rehta hai. Inductor jo opposition (rukawat) dalta hai use inductive reactance X_L kehte hain:

(b) Inductor voltage (red, peak Vo) aur inductor current (purple, peak Io) waqt ke saath, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi marked; jab current zero ho voltage peak par hota aur pi/2 aage hai. (c) VL reference line par aur IL us se 90 degree peeche, dono w par anticlockwise ghoomte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.7(a) mein current 'I = Iₒ sin(ω + t)' chhapa hai; sahi I = Iₒ sin ωt hai (ω aur t ka zarb, jama nahi). Graph mein dekhein: jab current zero se barhna shuru karta hai, voltage pehle hi peak par hota hai, yani voltage π/2 (90°) aage hai.
Yahan Vᵣₘₛ inductor par alternating voltage ki rms qeemat aur Iᵣₘₛ us mein guzarne wala rms current hai.

blocks.text_alt: As Vᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Vₒ and Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ, so
As Vₒ = ωLIₒ, so X_L = ωLIₒ/Iₒ

blocks.text: Yani X_L frequency aur inductance L dono ke directly proportional (seedha mutabiq) hai: f ya L dugna to X_L dugna. DC mein f = 0 hai, is liye X_L = 0; zyada frequency wale AC mein X_L bhi bara hota hai. Natija: inductor DC ko guzarne deta hai lekin AC ko rokta hai. X_L ki unit ohm hai.

Pure (khalis) inductor mein average power zero hoti hai. Inductor power kharch nahi karta: yeh energy magnetic field mein jama karta hai aur demagnetisation (field khatam hone) par source ko wapas kar deta hai. Har instant (lamha) ki power upar neeche hoti hai (kabhi energy andar, kabhi bahar), lekin ek cycle ki average power zero hoti hai, kyunke V aur I mein 90° ka phase difference hai. Is liye inductor energy kharch kiye baghair AC ko control karne ke kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke inductive circuit mein instantaneous power zero hai. Yeh sahi nahi: P = VI = ½VₒIₒ sin 2ωt hai, jo ek chauthai cycle positive (energy field mein jati hai) aur agli chauthai negative (energy wapas aati hai) hoti hai. Sirf poori cycle ka average zero hai.

blocks.text: Chokes ki types (qismein) (kitab mein tasveerein): filter choke, high frequency choke, radio frequency choke aur AC controlling choke.

blocks.prompt: Frequency dugni karne par inductor ki reactance ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bhi dugni ho jati hai, kyunke X_L = 2πfL, yani X_L frequency f ke directly proportional hai.

items: Inductor: V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2); voltage current se 90° aage (current peeche).
X_L = ωL = 2πfL: DC (f = 0) par zero, zyada f par bara.
